flags.summary: Not for sale — no instruction, no asking price
flags.detail: The villa appears on no sale listing on file, and does not appear in the DLD sale register between January 2018 and December 2024. It was marketed to let in February 2025. Nineteen years with one owner and a recent rental campaign does not read as a seller. Establish availability before anything else.

Palm Jumeirah is a designated freehold area, but that is a fact about the area, not proof of what this deed says. Read the deed and check the DLD record for mortgages, restrictions and outstanding service charge before making any tenure statement.

flags.summary: Areas come from a developer register, not a survey
flags.detail: 7,000 sq ft built and 13,000 sq ft plot are the register's round figures. The DLD record for the type gives 650.32 sq m built on a 1,244–1,246 sq m plot, which converts to ≈7,000 and ≈13,398–13,415 sq ft. Confirm against the deed before either number is used in a price per square foot a buyer relies on.

The supplied Drive folder has not been opened. Three checks outstanding: that the frames show this villa, that no identifiable person appears without agreement, and that no frame shows the villa number, a gate plate or a neighbour's plate. The last is a publication rule, not a preference.

flags.summary: An unconnected Edwards & Towers listing should not be confused with this villa
flags.detail: An E&T Instagram draft in the Drive offers 'two villas, one owner' on an extended 20,494 sq ft plot at AED 97,500,000, described as a 6-bed Signature plus a 4-bed Garden Home. The same registered owner does hold a second Palm villa, a 4-bed on another frond. But the two plots are on different fronds and total 19,500 sq ft, not 20,494, so they cannot be the extended plot described. Do not merge the two records without evidence.
